example_en: He found out that his friend was sick.
comment: Distinguish from عَرَفَ "to know, be acquainted with".

example_en: The president spoke to the people.
comment: Related adjective sense "main, chief" exists but noun sense is far more frequent.

example_en: He is the second student in the class.
comment: Loses nunation and keeps the ي when definite, as shown in the example.
Skipped the less common senses (to visit a patient, to become again) in favor of the basic 'return' sense most frequent in MSA.

example_en: He has a lot of time.
comment: Switched from the noun entry to the adjective entry, which matches how this word is actually used and inflected in MSA.
Kept the primary 'eye (organ)' sense; skipped the many secondary senses (spring, spy, evil eye, letter name, etc.) as less frequent for a learner.

example_en: How many books did the student read this month?
comment: Focused on the interrogative use ('how many?'), the one a learner meets constantly; the exclamative use ('how much!') is rarer.

example_en: My father worked in the police department.
comment: Skipped the rarer grammatical sense 'definiteness'.

example_en: The child will not understand this lesson.
My father is a kind man.
comment: Skipped the rarer sense 'ancestor, forefather'.

example_en: My brother bought a new car.
The student went to the university in the morning.
comment: Skipped the many extended senses (to think, to disappear, etc.) and the unrelated noun ذَهَب 'gold'; kept the basic motion sense, by far the most frequent.

example_en: Every person has a right to education.
comment: حَقّ also very commonly means 'truth' (especially in set phrases); not covered by this card. Skipped the homograph verb حَقَّ and the adjective sense.

example_en: He didn't attend because he was sick.
I love my life in this city.
I heard an important piece of news today.

comment: Dropped the rarer plural طُرُقَات.

example_en: When he arrived home, he called his father.
This box has a strange shape.
comment: Dropped the rarer plural شُكُول.

example_en: The minister came to the city yesterday.
comment: Chose the basic 'to come' sense, the most frequent in news MSA; other senses (to bring, to commit, etc.) are less common for a learner at this stage.

example_en: This is my first time here.
He has a problem at work.
They are students at the university.
His son is a student at the university.
comment: Dropped the rarer plural بَنُون and the less common senses (descendant, member of a group).
Skipped the archaic senses (to be extracted; to remain) and the unrelated noun حَصَل (unripe dates).

hint: (+ مِنْ someone + أَنْ to do something)
example_en: He asked me to wait here.
He works at a big company.

comment: Skipped the obsolete travel-related senses and the lunar-station sense.

example_en: No one knows the answer except him.

english: to become clear; to be evident
example_en: The truth became clear to everyone.
comment: Chose the 'become evident' sense of etymology 1 over the rarer 'part, separate' and unrelated plant/title entries.

example_en: The man believes that the news is true.
The lesson started a little while ago.
He took a beautiful picture of the city.
comment: Other senses (form, shape, manner) are less common for a learner than 'photo/picture'.

example_en: I haven't seen him for a year.
comment: Switched to the preposition entry: this is the far more common everyday use (مُنْذُ + time noun) than the conjunction use with a following clause.

example_en: I like neither coffee nor tea.
comment: Chose the idiomatic 'nor' sense (لا...ولا...), the one learners meet most; the plain compositional وَ+لَا is covered by those separate entries.
Chose the core 'to take' sense, by far the most common in MSA; other senses (to seize, to adopt, to perceive, etc.) are less frequent and omitted.

example_en: The president talked about this topic.
comment: Switched from the drafted noun entry (power/might, year) to the preposition حَوْلَ 'around, about', which is by far the sense a learner meets most in MSA.

example_en: The president visited the site of the accident.
comment: Also very common as 'website' (مَوْقِع إِلِكْتْرُونِيّ).

example_en: I waited a whole hour in front of the door.
comment: Also very common meaning 'watch, clock'. Dropped the rare plural سَاع.

example_en: He went to the market and then bought bread.
